text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her recent successes, epitomized 
by the Sprinters Stakes, the official URA 
mascot was selling like hotcakes.
Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We have a grave situation on our hands, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I will be far from becoming 
an Ultra Super Mascot."

I calmed her down as she seemed rather 
frantic, and listened closely to what she 
had to say...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Coming here to inspect was definitely 
worth it. Look at all these Machan dolls 
lined up."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It is truly lovely, and oh so cute...!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know her, Onee-chan! I have a doll 
of her at home!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? You have a wonderful eye 
for aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did you watch my race? I'll do my best 
again, so please come to the racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: The race? Didn't watch it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I bought it because it was 
cute.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—An eye-opening realization, a blind spot 
right under my nose. What an unexpected 
pitfall.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is true that the mascots are selling 
well. Glittering and shining, yes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Most people probably buy them after 
learning about Machan from watching the 
races.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems there are people who 
feel differently.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If you see the mascot without knowing 
Mar-chan's trace, it is merely just a 
mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is a situation that must be handled 
as urgently as possible.

Isn't there any good plan? As the two of 
us tilted our heads in thought—

The smartphone rang. It was an incoming 
call from the editorial department of a 
major publisher.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A... A book adaptation of my 4-panel comic 
blog...?!

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was wondering if we might be able 
to compile and publish the three years' 
worth of 4-panel manga that Trainer has 
saved up.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
Those 4-panel comics thoroughly record 
everything from Aston Machan-san's racing 
exploits to her everyday life, after all.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
Above all, perhaps because it's from the 
Trainer's point of view, it's nicely 
objective and the descriptions are just 
adorable!

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll make both those who 
recently discovered Chan-san and those 
who've supported her for a long time 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, mm. That is a very intriguing 
tale...!

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I heard that Aston Machan's long-cherished 
dream is to have URA's official mascot 
widely sold.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I think it will also indirectly contribute 
to the sales of that mascot.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
For example, I've never seen Aston Machan 
race. Yet, I still know her through the 
4-koma comics.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I think people like that would be more 
likely to pick up our mascot.

Aston Machan twitches in response to those 
words.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, even kids who haven't 
watched the races will know Chan is Chan 
and hug her mascot plushie.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's exactly it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Not just any mascot, but Aston Machan's 
mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To be remembered more widely and deeply. 
That means—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, we're one step away from becoming an 
Ultra Super Mascot, then.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text: ...You could say that too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer. This is a 
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

And so, the book adaptation talks 
progressed without a hitch――

It was decided that the 4-panel manga 
would soon be published as a book...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, ...what's your favorite food?
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
About getting published in book form. 
Machan has been thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That if it were just for Chan-Mi alone, 
she probably wouldn't have drawn the 
4-panel manga.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even if I had tried to draw it, it 
probably wouldn't have turned out 
objective or lovely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
All the effort you put into continuously 
creating something only you could make.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is why... I would like to know what 
your favorite food is.

...In other words, are they trying to 
thank me for something?

It was precisely because Aston Machan was 
trying so hard that I felt I wanted to 
help her, and—

Aston Machan's running was so incredible 
that I felt I just had to share it.
choice_data_list:
You're the one who made me want to tell 
you.
You made me want to tell you how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Merchandise is loved when it has a story 
behind it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It failed in the movie, but I feel like 
it'll work out this time."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"To the people who knew Mar-chan, and to 
those who didn't."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Forever and ever, into the distant 
future. I feel like I will be loved."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: By the way, what's your favorite food?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If you won't tell me, fine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I will buy some cake on the way back. Let 
us eat it together.
